we have an urgent role for Analyst Programmer role for fulltime opportunity. please share your profile at the earliest.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
? Experience in performing forensic analysis to identify anomalies or threats ? Experience in testing the software and application deployments ? Analysing improvement and continuous delivery strategies across system design and software development ? Experience in researching, and analysing the programming code.

? Preparing presentation and documentation based on the client requirements.
? Experience in diagnosing and correcting errors with quality standards to ensure the program and application perform to specification.
? Experience in developing the tools required for software and its security.
? Analyzing the risk of performance and security of software upgrades.
SKILLS:
•	Experience in supporting workforce access applications like RightCrowd and Gallagher (at least 3 years).
•	Experience in .NET Core and SQL Server.
•	Should have experience in front-end technologies like Angular or React.
•	Should have experience in leading teams for support of multi-tiered software applications
•	Should be well versed with ITIL processes for production support
•	Should be ready for on-call support as needed
•	Ability to plan and direct complex technical projects VHJHC.
•	Experience with MS SQL Server.
•	Excellent knowledge of data backup, recovery, security, integrity, and SQLFHDJDJ ? Ability to maintaining the company website and intranet site
•	Experience with strong background in .NET Framework using c#.net, ASP.NET and HTML and CSS.
•	Hands on experience in SIEM tool and web Security, web logic and web sphere as well
•	Proven history of creating effective support documentation
•	Experience in SSRS and MVC framework and visual studio
•	Experience in Object Oriented programming -Java and JavaScript.
•	Effectively co-ordinate with the team members
